description: This file defines a singleton object 'FirebaseConfig' responsible for initializing Firebase in an Android app. It retrieves configuration parameters from resource strings, and initializes Firebase only if all required keys are present. If the keys are missing or an error occurs, it logs warnings and skips initialization, effectively running in a mock mode.

classes.name: FirebaseConfig
classes.description: A singleton object that manages Firebase initialization based on resource string keys, enabling mock mode when keys are absent or invalid.

methods.name: initializeIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to initialize Firebase with parameters read from resources; returns true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: getStringResOrNull
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve a string resource by name; returns null if resource is not found.
